what: PyTorch .pth pickle uploaded to a Hugging Face account; when loaded with torch.load it runs a shell command that downloads a script from 194.34.254.219:10410 and pipes it to sh.

evidence.basis: Rapid7 prints this SHA-256 for ws.pth in the report's indicators of compromise and describes the command the pickle runs when it is deserialized.

source.title: From .pth to p0wned: Abuse of Pickle Files in AI Model Supply Chains
